cover_letter:
Dear Dalton team,

I'm excited to apply for the Marketing Lead position at Dalton. Your vision to make websites optimize themselves through AI-powered continuous experimentation aligns perfectly with my passion for leveraging technology to drive measurable growth. With a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I've been building digital experiences that perform across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, while also building and maintaining WordPress sites. This hands-on experience has taught me how to execute across multiple marketing channels simultaneously. On my personal project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical audits that measurably improved search health. I've also integrated social media and created content that engages audiences.

While I'm early in my career, I've developed a strong execution mindset. I'm comfortable on camera, having created video content for social channels, and I've managed paid campaigns through Google Ads. I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can test, learn, and iterate quickly. The opportunity to build Dalton's marketing engine from scratch—from video content and webinars to conference strategy and paid media—is exactly the challenge I'm seeking.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just a short commute from Ghent, and I'm eager to collaborate directly with founders at Wintercircus. I'm ready to turn Dalton's momentum into a movement.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Dalton's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
